The Meeting Before the Meeting

Prepare for an important meeting before you walk into it.

What it does

Before you walk in, it helps you figure out:

  • What matters
  • What you need to know
  • What you need to ask
  • What could derail the meeting
  • What decision should actually get made

When to use it

  • Before a meeting you can't afford to wing.
  • When there's a decision in the room and nobody has said what it is.

What to give it

  • Who's in the meeting and what it's supposedly about.
  • Any agenda, notes, emails or docs you already have.
  • What you want to walk out with.

What you get back

  • A short prep sheet: what matters, what to know, what to ask, what could go sideways.
  • The decision the meeting should actually make, in one sentence.

How to use this in Claude

  1. Download the .zip. Don’t unzip it.
  2. In the Claude app, open Settings and find Skills.
  3. Upload the .zip and switch it on.
  4. Start a new chat and just ask for the thing. Claude picks up the Skill on its own.

Works on any Claude plan that has Skills turned on.
